description: Header file defining the InputManager class and related interfaces for Android's native input system, including components like InputReader, InputProcessor, InputDispatcher, and interaction with system services.

classes.name: InputManagerInterface
classes.description: Abstract interface for the Android input manager, providing methods to start, stop, retrieve components, monitor, and dump state.

classes.name: InputManager
classes.description: Concrete implementation of InputManagerInterface, managing input reading, processing, dispatching, and system interaction.

methods.name: monitor
methods.description: Checks for deadlocks or issues in input stages.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of input components.

methods.name: dump (overloaded)
methods.description: Dumps state information to a file descriptor with arguments.

methods.name: createInputChannel
methods.description: Creates a new input channel with a given name.

methods.name: removeInputChannel
methods.description: Removes an input channel identified by a connection token.

methods.name: setFocusedWindow
methods.description: Sets the focus to a specific window.
